conditions.answer: The syllabus does not allow you to use AI tools to generate code or turn in work that is not your own. You are responsible for the content you turn in, and you can use AI tools as a tutor or source for debugging any issues that come up. The Discord API token is not something you would turn in, but rather something you need to set up in your Discord environment. You should not paste your bot's Discord API token into ChatGPT or anywhere else. Instead, you should set up your own Discord test server and group deployment server, and then use the Discord API token to authenticate your bot. This will help you identify and fix the auth error. Your group deployment server should be set up in class, and your Discord test server should be set up in your individual environment. Once you've set up your test server, ping Dr. Champion in Discord to let her know you're done, and then she'll invite you to the group deployment server.
